# Design System Reskin Checklist: UI Reskin to Broadsheet Design System

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage — across the reskin's design-token model (color, typography, spacing, radius), accessibility/contrast obligations, and the full in-scope page/component surface, before implementation proceeds.
**Created**: 2026-09-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements defined for every named palette role (background, surface, text, primary accent, secondary accent, neutral ramp, semantic danger/advisory), with an explicit source-of-truth for each new value? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for how the three-typeface assignment (heading/prose, chrome, machine values) resolves for markup that mixes a heading and a machine value in the same element (e.g., an issue title containing an identifier)? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Is the full set of "reusable UI elements already in use" enumerated with enough specificity that a reviewer can confirm none was omitted from FR-004's restyle scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the boundary/error pages (not-found, forbidden) with the same states-and-scenarios rigor given to the named application pages? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for a decorative flourish (FR-010) that is started but not finished on a given surface, rather than only the fully-included/fully-excluded cases? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "near-square corner radii" quantified with a specific value or range, rather than left to reviewer interpretation? [Clarity, Spec Input; Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK007 Is "the new palette's values" (FR-001) traceable to a single authoritative source of exact values, rather than left implicit in prose? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK008 Is "match" (used throughout FR-001–FR-005) defined with an objective pass/fail criterion, or does it rely on subjective visual judgment? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001-FR-005]
- [x] CHK009 Is "genuinely elevated" (the exception carved out for shadows versus hairlines) defined with a closed list of qualifying surfaces, rather than left to case-by-case judgment? [Clarity, Data-Model §Shadow step]
- [x] CHK010 Is "arbitrary pixel value" defined precisely enough to distinguish a value that must be nudged to the 5px spacing scale from a layout constraint that legitimately stays arbitrary? [Clarity, Contracts/design-tokens.md Rule 4]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the auth-screen states enumerated in spec.md (User Story 1) match the states enumerated in the page-inventory contract for the same routes? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1; Contracts/page-inventory.md]
- [x] CHK012 Is FR-005's "active/hover states" requirement for the shell consistent with the "selected-state styling" language used for navigation items in the component-patterns contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005; Contracts/component-patterns.md]
- [x] CHK013 Do FR-007's interactive-state list (hover, pressed, focus, selected, disabled, error, loading, empty) and the per-pattern "state check" lists in component-patterns.md cover the same states for every pattern, with none named in one but dropped in the other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007; Contracts/component-patterns.md]

## Design Token Coverage — Color, Typography, Spacing, Radius

- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for every named palette role with an explicit contrast obligation for each foreground/background pairing that appears on a restyled surface? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001; Data-Model §Palette role token]
- [x] CHK015 Is there a requirement covering how a ramp step is chosen or validated when no existing contrast-test pairing already exercises it, beyond "a role token no pairing references is dead"? [Gap, Data-Model §Palette role token]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for which typeface a machine value nested inside a heading or button label resolves to, when the heading-face rule and the mono-face rule could both apply to the same element? [Gap, Contracts/design-tokens.md Rule 3]
- [x] CHK017 Is the spacing-scale conformance requirement measurable — can a reviewer objectively determine, for any class name in the file sweep, whether it already sits on the new 5px unit or needs to be nudged? [Measurability, Plan §Source code]
- [x] CHK018 Are the radius opt-out cases (`rounded-full`, hard-square) specified as a closed, enumerated list of which elements may opt out, rather than left to per-file judgment during the sweep? [Clarity, Contracts/design-tokens.md Rule 5]
- [x] CHK019 Is the "rules, not boxes" layout convention specified with a testable boundary between "separator" and "genuinely elevated," so two reviewers would classify the same card the same way? [Measurability, Contracts/design-tokens.md Rule 6]

## Accessibility & Contrast

- [x] CHK020 Are contrast requirements (SC-003) specified for every state a control can be in (disabled, placeholder, error text on its error background), not only its resting state? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK021 Is the non-color-only-signaling requirement (Edge Cases, auth-screen messages) extended to every semantic state used elsewhere in the product (success, advisory), or scoped only to the auth screens named in that edge case? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK022 Is there a requirement for what happens if a new WCAG pairing the reskin introduces fails the 4.5:1/3:1 threshold — is the ramp value rejected, or is there a fallback/escalation path? [Gap, Contracts/design-tokens.md §Non-negotiables]
- [x] CHK023 Are focus-indicator requirements (FR-008) specified for visibility against every background the new palette introduces (accent-fill buttons, dialog surfaces), not only the default page background? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK024 Is the reduced-motion requirement (Edge Cases) specific enough to verify against — does it name which motion, if any, this feature introduces, or does it only state a general constraint with nothing concrete to check? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Scope Completeness — Page & Component Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Does every route file listed in the page-inventory contract map back to a named requirement or user story in spec.md, with none left implicitly covered only by "all existing UI surfaces"? [Traceability, Contracts/page-inventory.md]
- [x] CHK026 Is the root `not-found` boundary (outside either route group) held to the same explicit, testable requirement as the in-shell not-found and forbidden boundaries, given it renders without the shell's styling context? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases; Contracts/page-inventory.md]
- [x] CHK027 For the wrapper/redirect surfaces the page-inventory contract marks as needing no content edit, is there a requirement to confirm they render no unstyled UI of their own, or does this rely on an unverified assumption? [Gap, Contracts/page-inventory.md §Untouched by route]
- [x] CHK028 Is the dialog-shell extraction's scope (eight named call sites) stated as closed and complete, with a requirement confirming no ninth dialog exists elsewhere in the codebase that also needs the shared shell? [Completeness, Contracts/component-patterns.md §Dialogs]
- [x] CHK029 Is the hardcoded-color fix (`toast-region.tsx`) specified precisely enough — which variants, which tokens each moves to — that a reviewer can confirm it is fully covered rather than partially fixed? [Clarity, Plan §Source code]
- [x] CHK030 Is there a requirement or mechanism to confirm the full component sweep is exhaustive, i.e., that no file outside the named feature directories was missed? [Gap, Plan §Scale/Scope]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK031 Is SC-001's "zero surfaces retain the prior visual system" objectively verifiable given no automated visual-regression tooling exists, or does it rely entirely on a manual walkthrough as the only evidence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK032 Is SC-002's "changes limited to visual/style assertions" independently checkable, or does it require a reviewer to manually diff every modified test file to confirm no functional assertion moved? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK033 Is SC-004's "no change in the number of steps required" defined against a documented baseline, or is the baseline only implicit in "today"? [Gap, Spec §SC-004]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK034 Is it specified whether the decorative-flourish exception (FR-010) must be all-or-nothing across the product, or whether per-surface inclusion is allowed? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK035 Are requirements defined for a mixed-rollout state (e.g., cached assets from the prior token set alongside newly deployed ones)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 Is the assumption that "no dark theme exists today and none is introduced" validated against the codebase, or stated without a verification step? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK037 Is the pre-existing, unapproved `clsx` dependency gap tracked as a follow-up item with an owner, or does it remain an unresolved note with no remediation requirement? [Assumption, Plan §Complexity Tracking]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK038 Does the documentation edit to the product specification's Palette section conflict with the stated authority rule that the product specification is "silent on how," and if so, is that conflict's resolution documented anywhere reviewable beyond the plan's own justification? [Conflict, Plan §Complexity Tracking]
- [x] CHK039 Is there a documented resolution for the potential conflict between "no functional change" and the dialog-shell extraction, which changes markup structure across seven files — is "extraction with identical rendered behavior" specified precisely enough to be checked? [Conflict, Spec §FR-009; Contracts/component-patterns.md §Dialogs]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
